subject: Urgent: coordination for Friday demo — sandbox unavailable, need coverage & procurement items
messages:
From: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: InfraOps Team <infraops@clearpath.com>, ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo on Fri — embargoed maintenance window

Evelyn, 

Quick update from infra: our hosted sandbox that we planned to use for Friday's demo is under an emergency maintenance window that was just scheduled by our data center team. They expect the environment to be unavailable from 14:00–22:00 PDT on Aug 28. That conflicts with the 15:00 PDT slot we booked.

Given that the demo relies on live API keys and a reachable sandbox, we need to either:
- move the session to another day/time, or
- run a reduced, offline walk-through using a recording and a limited Q&A (we won't be able to hand off credentials).

Also copying procurement — there are a couple of outstanding items on the SOW they flagged; that needs to be cleared before a full production-focused demo.

Sam
InfraOps
ClearPath Systems

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on Fri — embargoed maintenance window

Thanks for the heads up, Sam — appreciate the quick notice.

Short plan from our side: 
- We can propose two alternative live windows (Mon Aug 31 10:00 PDT or Tue Sep 1 14:00 PDT).
- If a live session isn't possible, we can do a 30–40m pre-recorded walkthrough of the integration flows + a 20m live Q&A.

Hiro — heads-up: the session content will include a walkthrough of token-level observability and the routing policy demos. Are you available to present on Mon/Tue? If not, can Aditya or Laura cover?

Procurement — noted on the SOW items. Can you confirm which clauses need redlines so we can triage? If procurement needs a separate call, we can set one up ASAP.

Action items: 
- Sam: confirm whether ClearPath prefers reschedule vs recorded walk-through.
- Procurement: send the checklist / redline summary.
- Hiro/Aditya/Laura: confirm availability for the two proposed windows (Mon/Tue).

Thanks — I can set the calendar tentatives once we have confirmation.

— Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on Fri — embargoed maintenance window

Evelyn / Sam —
Heads up, I'm traveling and offline from Aug 27–30 (conference travel). I won't be available for the Fri slot or the Mon Aug 31 morning window. I can do Tue Sep 1 after 13:00 PDT though.

If the team needs the material earlier, Aditya can step in for the routing / optimization portion — he's briefed on the model routing and quantization recommendations. Laura could take the observability and rollout examples.

Aditya / Laura — are either of you able to take the Aug 31 or Sep 1 sessions as a fallback? If you do, I'll hand over my deck and notes (short checklist attached).

— Hiro
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: hiro-hand-off-checklist.txt (attachment stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>, Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>
Cc: ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on Fri — embargoed maintenance window

I can cover the routing & cost optimization segments on Aug 31 (10:00 PDT) or Sep 1 (14:00 PDT). Prefer Sep 1 if Hiro is available then, but Aug 31 works as well.

Quick note for procurement: to run the live environment for the demo we usually need:
- temporary sandbox credentials (API key with demo-only scope)
- confirmation of data retention sandbox policy (for metrics view)
- a signed minimal MSA addendum or a PO number to allow provisioning to proceed (procurement often provides the PO after the redline items are resolved).

If you can attach the procurement checklist here, I'll review and call out anything blocking the demo for the engineering portion.

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on Fri — embargoed maintenance window (procurement items)

Evelyn / Aditya —
Attached is a short checklist and our redline summary (procurement-checklist.pdf and redline-sow.docx). Key items we need resolved before we finalize a production-focused demo:
- Liability and data residency paragraph — need clarity on where logs/metrics are stored for demo runs.
- Billing trigger for provisioning demo capacity — need a temporary PO or written approval.
- Retention duration for observability artifacts — request 30-day default.

If we can agree on the above in writing by EOD Fri (Aug 28), procurement is OK to allow a live sandbox for the next week. If not, we'll need to default to an on-recording walkthrough.

Procurement Team
ClearPath Systems
Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf, redline-sow.docx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@clearpath.com>, ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo coordination — coverage and next steps

Thanks everyone for the rapid responses and for the procurement attachments — that helps a lot. Quick recap and next steps: 

Recap:
- Live sandbox unavailable on Aug 28 due to ClearPath maintenance.
- Procurement has sent redlines; they need agreement by EOD Fri Aug 28 to keep a live window next week.
- Hiro unavailable Aug 27–30; Aditya has offered to present the routing/optimization portion. Laura can present the observability examples.

Proposed plan (please confirm):
1) Tentative live session: Tue Sep 1 14:00 PDT — Hiro will present remotely (he's back and can join after 13:00 PDT). Aditya will own routing + cost controls, Laura will own observability and rollout demos.
2) If procurement cannot clear the SOW items by EOD Aug 28, we'll instead send a 40m recorded walkthrough + 20m live Q&A on the same Tue Sep 1 14:00 PDT slot (no sandbox credentials required).
3) I'll create a calendar invite with two event descriptions (live vs recorded) and update once procurement confirms.

Action items: 
- Sam: confirm preference (live vs recorded) by EOD Mon Aug 30.
- Procurement: confirm whether the three checklist items are acceptable for a PO or provide an alternate timeline.
- Aditya/Laura/Hiro: confirm final slides to hand off to me by Mon Aug 30 COB.

Attachments: evelyn-demo-agenda.md (agenda + proposed slide owners)

If the team is aligned, I'll go ahead and pencil Sep 1 and share the invite with the ClearPath calendar.

— Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
